The facts: The defendant Meng, legal representative of a cooperative, from 2013-2014 stole 1451 trees (林木) from national forest (natural forest) that were cut by others, without forestry department approval, used for the cooperative. Value 27,465 yuan. Also, from 2012 onward, he occupied land in a forest area (林场) to build pig farm without approval. Occupied forest land (including protective forest, water conservation forest). Total about 5.97 mu (approx 0.4 ha). So crimes: illegal logging/illegal harvesting of forest resources (滥伐林木) or illegal occupation of forest land. Also "非法占用农用地" for illegal occupation of farmland. Here it's forest land, so "非法占用林地" maybe. Also "盗窃林木" maybe considered theft of forest resources. The earlier example: "滥伐林木" used for cutting without permit. That case: "庞某...未办理林木采伐许可证...砍伐...". Answer: 滥伐林木. So for stealing trees, likely same: 滥伐林木. For occupying forest land for pig farm, maybe "非法占用林地". In examples, they used "非法占用农用地" for illegal occupation of farmland. For forest, maybe "非法占用林地". But not sure if there is a specific crime name. Could be "非法占用林地" or "非法占用林业用地". The Chinese criminal law has article 338 for illegal occupation of forest land? Actually article 338 is "非法占用农用地". For forest, there is article 338 also? Not sure. But typical crime: "非法占用林地" is used. So answer likely two crimes: 滥伐林木;非法占用林地.

Thus final answer: [罪名]滥伐林木;非法占用林地<eoa>
